units.source_text: 这玉鬘是谁的女儿，他们一向连官邸里的人也不让晓得。

en.t: They had never let even the people in the residence know whose daughter this Tamakazura was.

units.source_text: 对人但言这是外孙女儿，是身份高贵的人。

en.t: They merely told others that she was a granddaughter, and a person of noble birth.

units.source_text: 数年来生长深闺，不令人见。

en.t: For several years she had been raised deep within the women's quarters, where no one was allowed to see her.

units.source_text: 如今少弍突然身故，乳母等非常悲伤，孤苦无依，只得遵守遗嘱，设法迁回京都。

en.t: Now that the Assistant Governor had suddenly died, the nurse and the others were overwhelmed with grief and left helpless, so they had no choice but to follow his will and find a way to move back to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 然而在这筑紫地方，少弍有许多冤家。

en.t: But in the Tsukushi region, the Assistant Governor had many enemies.

units.source_text: 乳母深恐此等人将用种种计谋来妨碍他们归京，因此迁延不决，不知不觉地又在这里滞留了几年。

en.t: The nurse deeply feared that these people would use every sort of scheme to obstruct their return to the capital, so she hesitated and delayed, and before they knew it they had remained there for several more years.

units.source_text: 玉鬘渐次长成，容貌之美胜过母亲夕颜。

en.t: Tamakazura gradually grew up, and the beauty of her face surpassed even that of her mother Yugao.

units.source_text: 加之秉承父亲血统，气品高尚优雅，性情又温良贤淑，真是个绝代佳人。

en.t: Moreover, inheriting her father's lineage, she possessed a noble and graceful air, and her nature was gentle, kind, wise, and modest; she was truly a peerless beauty.

units.source_text: 当地好色的田舍儿闻此消息，都恋慕她，有许多人寄情书来求婚。

en.t: When the amorous country youths of the area heard the news, they all fell in love with her, and many sent love letters asking for marriage.

units.source_text: 但乳母认为荒唐可恶，一概置之不理。

en.t: But the nurse found it absurd and detestable, and ignored them all without exception.

units.source_text: 为避免烦扰，她向外扬言：“这妮子相貌虽然生得还好，可惜身上患着沉重的残疾，所以不能配亲，只好让她当尼姑。

en.t: To avoid the harassment, she spread word outside: "Although this girl was born with passable looks, unfortunately she suffers from a serious disability, so she cannot be married off and must simply become a nun.

units.source_text: 我活着的期间，且让她住在我身边吧。”

en.t: While I am alive, I will let her stay by my side."

units.source_text: 外人便传说：“已故的少弍的外孙女是个残废者，真可惜了。”

en.t: People outside then began saying, "The late Assistant Governor's granddaughter is disabled; what a pity."

units.source_text: 乳母听到了又很生气。

en.t: When the nurse heard this, she became very angry again.

units.source_text: 她叹息道：“总须设法送她进京，教她父亲知道才好。

en.t: She sighed and said, "Somehow I must send her to the capital and let her father know about her.

units.source_text: 她幼小时候，父亲非常宠爱她，虽然长久不见了，总不会因此舍弃她吧。”

en.t: When she was little, her father cherished her dearly; even though he has not seen her for a long time, surely he would not abandon her for that reason."

units.source_text: 便向神佛祈祷，祝她早日返京。

en.t: So she prayed to the gods and Buddhas, wishing that Tamakazura might return to the capital soon.

units.source_text: 此时乳母的女儿和儿子都已在本地择配，婚嫁完毕，做了本地的居民了。

en.t: By this time, the nurse's daughters and sons had all found spouses locally, completed their marriages, and become residents of the area.

units.source_text: 乳母心中虽然焦灼，然而玉鬘返京之事仿佛越来越少希望。

en.t: Although the nurse was anxious at heart, Tamakazura's return to the capital seemed to grow less and less hopeful.

units.source_text: 玉鬘已经明白自己身世，但觉人生真太痛苦。

en.t: Tamakazura already understood her own origins, and felt only that life was truly too painful.

units.source_text: 她每年三次斋戒祭星。

en.t: Three times each year she purified herself with fasting and worshiped the stars.

units.source_text: 到了二十岁上，相貌更加长得漂亮了，住在这乡间实甚可惜！

en.t: By the time she reached twenty, her appearance had grown even more beautiful, and it was truly a great pity for her to be living in this countryside.

units.source_text: 此时他们已迁居肥前国。

en.t: By then they had already moved to Hizen Province.

units.source_text: 当地也有许多略有声望的人，闻知少弍的外孙女是个美人，也都不断地前来求婚。

en.t: There were also many people of some standing in that area, and when they heard that the Assistant Governor's granddaughter was beautiful, they too kept coming to ask for marriage.

units.source_text: 乳母不胜其烦，讨厌之极。

en.t: The nurse could no longer bear the annoyance and found it utterly hateful.
